narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as an educational and promotional beauty vlog focused on the maintenance of long bangs. The creator explains that even long fringe needs regular professional trimming to achieve a 'wispy' and layered look that frames the face properly when styling or tying hair back. The intent is to encourage female viewers to maintain their hairstyles through professional salon services.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The presence of branded salon capes and a professional stylist performing the service indicates a collaboration or endorsement of the hair salon.
